text: Asthma check. Assessment: mild intermittent asthma. Current smoker, about 10 cigarettes a day. Pt on Flovent HFA 125 mcg 2 puffs BID. Chart note from the walk-in lists PHN SYNTH-PHN-0000.
Seen in the airways clinic. Spirometry reversible. Assessment: severe persistent asthma, eosinophilic phenotype. Tezepelumab recommended.
Tezepelumab 210 mg SC q4w started 2025-03-04. Dupilumab was discussed but not started.
Asthma exacerbation. Prednisone 40 mg x 5 days.
Tezepelumab discontinued 2025-10-20; patient reports no benefit. Continue inhalers.
Seen for asthma flare-up with night cough. Started prednisone 40 mg x 5 days.
CBC with differential. Collection date: 2026-01-20. Eos (abs) 0.71 x10^9/L. Reprinted 2026-10-01.
Tendinitis of the right elbow. Prednisone 20 mg x 5 days. Asthma quiet.
Her mom had a severe asthma attack last week and was given prednisone 40 mg x 5 days. Patient well.
Ex-smoker, quit 2025-01-05. Husband smokes outside. Prednisone not needed this spring.

Discharge summary for the asthma exacerbation of 2026-08-02. Medrol dose pack 4 mg continued.
